metadata_caption: Backstory: Kay has talked about wanting to visit there for nearly 10 years! ❤️ I have always told her that one day we’d be able to afford it, but life has always gotten in the way. Then, once Kay told me that she was pregnant in early March, I immediately started to put in extra hours at work. I made it my goal to get her to Hawaii before we had baby bean! She deserves this trip so so much, and I can’t wait to see her face light up when we get there. ❤️🥹 Also Update on Gravy: Kay and I have been looking around for a new cat, but haven’t found the one yet.
